title: eucalyptus incrassata subsp. angulosa
intro: Eucalyptus incrassata subsp. angulosa, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Scribbly Gum, is a plant species native to Australia, characterized by its distinctive, scribbled bark. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including relief from colds, coughs, and fever, as well as aiding in digestion and reducing inflammation. Therapeutically, Eucalyptus incrassata subsp. angulosa is used as an expectorant to relieve congestion, a decongestant to reduce swelling, and an anti-inflammatory to soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include various compounds such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
